crossRefs.note: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter…
Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
“However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You…
But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned…
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will…
‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in…
to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment…
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

translations.web: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”
translations.bsb: It will be a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you shall humble yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to keep your Sabbath.”
translations.kjv: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
translations.asv: It shall be unto you a sabbath of solemn rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye keep your sabbath.
